notes.title: SHORT-DEMO NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
[p][b]🎉 Our Short Demo is Live on Itch.io![/b][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]The [b]free short demo[/b] for [i]Peek a Doom[/i] is now available to play on [b]Itch.io[/b]![/p][p]🕹 [b]Step into the nightmare:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Explore the haunted halls of Willby School[/p][/*][*][p]Face terrifying monster teachers who hunt you down[/p][/*][*][p]Solve dangerous puzzles to unlock new areas[/p][/*][*][p]Sneak, hide, and survive long enough to stop the cult’s ritual[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just a small slice of what’s to come; the full game will bring [b]more monster teachers, bigger areas, intense chase sequences, and multiple endings[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Play the demo now: [/b] [url="https://enigmastudio-sarl.itch.io/peek-a-doom" style="button"]PLAY NOW[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback means everything to us. Let us know what scared you most and what you’d like to see next.[/p][p]Thanks for all the support,[/p][p]
Enigma Studio Team.[/p][p][/p]
